tools.name: rivioo_my_apps
tools.description: List the apps this Rivioo user saved: their own apps and competitors, each with store, app_id and default country (for Google Play the default country picks the review languages). Use it to look up an app the user names before calling rivioo_review_stats, rivioo_search_reviews or rivioo_get_reviews.

tools.name: rivioo_find_app
tools.description: Search the App Store and Google Play for apps by name in one storefront country (for Google Play the country later picks the review languages). Returns each match's app_id per store, developer, rating and store links. Use it for apps that are not in rivioo_my_apps; ask the user for the country if it

tools.name: rivioo_review_stats
tools.description: Exact rating distribution for one app over a window: total reviews, average rating, reviews per star and developer replies, also by app version (newest first, then other and unknown) and by week (weeks start Monday, UTC). Counts are the reviews Rivioo holds in the window, not users or every review e

tools.name: rivioo_search_reviews
tools.description: Exact counts of the reviews of one app that mention specific words, plus snippets with review IDs. It is the tool for "how many reviews mention X" questions and for sizing themes found while reading reviews with rivioo_get_reviews. App Store results are per country. tools.name: rivioo_get_reviews
tools.description: Returns a page of full reviews of one app: reviews, not counts. To count how many reviews mention a theme, use rivioo_search_reviews. Every review has a review_id, and a url when the store has one (App Store reviews have no per-review link), to cite when quoting. App Store results are per country. G

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "rivioo_my_apps" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
